candidates.description: This vector represents specific occurrences, instances, or situations in time and context.
This vector activates strongly for various conjugated forms of French auxiliary and modal verbs indicating action, possibility, or necessity.
This vector represents quantifying words, numbers, and numerical amounts across different languages.
This vector represents directional prepositions and positional prefixes across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on tokens and subwords containing the English character sequence "rick" or related to the sport of cricket.
This vector represents descriptive adjectives, particularly those indicating degree, size, priority, or ordinal position.
This feature vector represents common French adverbs and degree modifiers.
This vector activates strongly for common French transitional adverbs and modifiers denoting sequence, continuation, or emphasis.
This feature vector represents numerical digits or integer values.
The shared concept is participation in or reference to various sports, athletic games, and related teams or activities.
